meta.title: Security Gate
meta.description: Dependency advisories and contextual static evidence for plugin review. API usage alone is not a malware verdict; automatic disabling requires a high-confidence malicious review.

en.autoDisableHint: Only high-confidence malicious reviews can auto-disable. Static evidence never auto-disables. Never turns automatic disabling off.
en.autoUpgradeHint: shows upgrade commands for vulnerable deps (an upgrade pulls new code and is never run silently)
en.bundleDisabledHint: Disabled in the plugin manager, in step with the Plugins page; while it is still loaded (until restart) its tool calls are blocked. Choose Enable to restore it
en.cleanHint: no observations in the scanned scope; not a review or safety guarantee
en.emptyFilter: No plugins under the current filter.
en.gateHint: Call gate: a tool call into a high-risk plugin asks Allow once / Allow / Disable. Disable and Uninstall run through the plugin manager, in step with the Plugins page; a plugin disabled on either page has its tool calls blocked. Enable also allows the current version of a high-risk plugin.
en.modeEnforceHint: Only high-confidence malicious reviews can auto-disable; static evidence needs review
en.policyAllowedHint: This version may run without asking; a new version is judged again
en.policyBlockedHint: Every tool call from this plugin is blocked; choose Enable to restore it
en.protectedNote: Protected list (never auto-disabled): this plugin, official @deepseek-ai/*, dsh-plugin-sentinel
en.restartHint: removed from profile and quarantined, effective after restart
en.riskClear: No risk detected in this scan
en.riskMeaning: High risk: confirmed malicious behavior or high/critical dependency advisories. Risk detected: unresolved behavior, other advisories or incomplete checks. No risk detected: none found in this scan, not a safety guarantee. API capability observations alone do not establish risk.
en.staticHint: Static matches are not malware verdicts. Process execution, networking, configuration access and base64 decoding have legitimate uses. Review data flow, execution paths and feature purpose. Static findings never auto-disable an unreviewed plugin.
en.subtitle: Security Gate
en.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall {name}? It is removed through the plugin manager (the same as uninstalling on the Plugins page).
en.upgradeConfirm: Upgrade {name}? Runs the recorded pnpm add command — this installs new code.
en.upgradeOk: Upgraded {name}; the next scan re-audits it
en.whitelistDefaultHint: Default protection cannot be removed here
en.whitelistHint: Plugins on this list skip scanning and disposal entirely; the default protection seats (this plugin, official @deepseek-ai/*, dsh-plugin-sentinel) always apply
en.whitelistRowHint: Whitelisted plugins skip scanning and disposal
